value.answer: Depends a bit on your down payment. If you're putting down under 20% (insured), the lowest 5-year fixed I can see right now is 4.34%, with Frank Mortgage offering it. If you're putting down 20% or more (uninsured), the lowest is around 4.44%. The big banks are higher, averaging about 5.14%, and rates are creeping up this month. I can't check the exact number at your lender, so get a quote from them for the final figure.
